testingGaps: The dedicated indexed bridge-reader test uses deliberately invalid raw transaction bytes and therefore exercises fixed-entry metadata rejection only through the serialized-call-and-state boundary. Exact receipt insertion is tested separately against generated bridge execution, and the concrete verifier uses labeled source observations. A valid serialized bridge transaction/state fixture passing through createIndexedEvidenceBridgeDecisionReceiptReader, plus wrong serialized entry/module and missing insertion variants, would cover the remaining local handoff between those checks (packages/midnight-authorization/test/indexed-decision-receipt.test.ts:71-98; packages/midnight-authorization/test/evidence-bridge.test.ts:10-25; packages/evidence-vault/test/midnight-verifier.test.ts:44-59). No receipt-authenticity bypass was established.
residualRisks: Production access still depends on trusted host provisioning of per-binding/per-recipient credentials, the pinned finalized-source adapter, and the mandatory authenticated assertCurrentAuthorization callback. The local HTTP/SQLite and generated-circuit checks do not establish those deployed identity/status/network boundaries (packages/evidence-vault/src/server.ts:43-48,112-114; packages/evidence-vault/src/midnight-verifier.ts:23-32,55-72). These remain explicitly documented integration gates, not established code defects.

The changed contract has generated execution bindings but no current keys/build-manifest.json or executeRuntimeEvidenceBridge proving/verifier assets. The unchanged verifyPermioAuthorizationAssets check is still called before deploy/connect and fails closed; real proof, deployment, activation and finalized live acceptance remain unverified (packages/midnight-authorization/src/compiled-assets.ts:19-54; packages/midnight-authorization/src/midnight-contract.ts:107-137; docs/evidence/M10/finalized-bridge-development.md:65-71).
